edges.reason: Constructor parameter _newImplementation is assigned to the implementation state variable.
Constructor parameter _operator is assigned to the operator state variable.
Constructor parameter _validatorFactory is assigned to the validatorFactory state variable.
setValidatorImplementation writes its untrusted-shaped parameter into the implementation state variable.
setOperator writes its parameter into the operator state variable.
isValidatorFactory reads validatorFactory to compare it against msg.sender.
msg.sender determines whether the isValidatorFactory require check passes.
isValidatorFactory gates execution of setValidatorImplementation.
isValidatorFactory gates execution of setOperator.
_implementation returns the implementation state variable to the proxy.
Any untrusted caller can trigger fallback with arbitrary calldata, which delegates execution to the implementation.
fallback invokes _fallback internally.
receive invokes _fallback internally when calldata is empty.
_fallback calls the _beforeFallback hook before delegating.
_fallback delegates the call through _delegate.
_delegate consumes the address returned by _implementation as the delegatecall target.
ValidatorProxy override of _implementation supplies the delegation target address to _delegate.
_delegate forwards all msg.data via delegatecall to an implementation address; a malicious or mutated implementation can reenter the proxy and execute arbitrary logic in its storage context.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Ownable constructor passes _msgSender() into _transferOwnership to set the initial owner.
onlyOwner compares owner() with the untrusted _msgSender() result to authorize the call.
onlyOwner reads owner() when evaluating its authorization require statement.
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership to the current owner.
onlyOwner restricts transferOwnership to the current owner.
transferOwnership forwards its newOwner parameter into _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the newOwner parameter into the _owner state variable.
_transferOwnership reads the _owner state variable into the oldOwner local variable.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership calls the internal _transferOwnership function.
renounceOwnership calls _transferOwnership with the zero address.
The inherited Ownable constructor calls _transferOwnership(_msgSender()) during deployment.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _newImplementation only exists to initialize storage inside the ValidatorProxy constructor.
Constructor parameter _operator only exists to initialize storage inside the ValidatorProxy constructor.
Constructor parameter _validatorFactory only exists to initialize storage inside the ValidatorProxy constructor.
_newValidatorImplementation is the sole argument of setValidatorImplementation and has no independent semantics.
_newOperator is the sole argument of setOperator and has no independent semantics.
The implementation parameter is only used as the _delegate delegatecall target.
newOwner is the argument of transferOwnership and should be folded into that function.
newOwner of _transferOwnership is only used to write the owner storage slot inside that function.
oldOwner is a temporary local variable used only for the ownership-transfer event inside _transferOwnership.
